notes.title: The logistic quarter-turn
notes.summary: A two-cycle has return multiplier −1 at r = 1 + √6. Its paired derivative matrix has fourth power I, and the fourth-return displacement has zero first derivative at the cycle points.
notes.nextStep: Specify a geometric collapse model before connecting this local cancellation to a surface or brane. State its variables, map, topology and the exact sense in which a quantity vanishes.

notes.title: Alternating real towers
notes.summary: For every real base c > 1, the alternating-sign system has one pair of phases. The explicit iteration converges from every upper starting phase at least 1, with a uniform contraction bound.
notes.nextStep: Perform a focused literature search and request external review of this complete small theorem. A numerical match to a target constant needs an additional arithmetic argument.

notes.title: A dyadic vanishing remainder
notes.summary: The lacunary series f(x) = Σ x^(2ⁿ) obeys f(x) = x + f(x²). Along the specified dyadic path toward 1, subtracting k and a convergent constant leaves an explicit geometric tail.
notes.nextStep: Compare other explicitly defined approaches to the boundary while keeping path-dependent constants separate. Any link to a zeta remainder must be a new statement with its own bound.

notes.title: Prime polynomials count exactly
notes.summary: Finite polynomial products encode ordered Goldbach representations and twin-prime translations. A diagonal correction converts ordered Goldbach counts into unordered counts.
notes.nextStep: Identify an additional inequality or structural statement that could control the coefficients. Rewriting the count by itself is not a lower-bound argument.

notes.title: The Z(p) family under Schanuel
notes.summary: Euler’s even-zeta formula gives exact rational coefficients cₚ for every odd integer p ≥ 3. Assuming complex Schanuel, π and any finite list of the corresponding Z(p) values are algebraically independent.
notes.nextStep: Check the literature for this specific consequence and investigate unconditional statements separately. Small numerical coefficients do not strengthen the truth status of Schanuel.

notes.title: Two constructions of six
notes.summary: The additive and multiplicative constructions of six define different fractional exponential maps. Their smooth-branch derivatives give exact finite-time Lyapunov averages in terms of separate orbit means.
notes.nextStep: Define the orbit or invariant measure of interest and establish the limiting means before evaluating a zero-difference target. Keep the two maps’ means separate.

notes.title: Palindrome counting and its limits
notes.statusLabel: Exact count under a sampling model
notes.summary: For independent uniform q-symbol strings of length n, ordinary palindromes have probability q^−floor(n/2). The example q = 4, n = 40 has probability exactly 2⁻⁴⁰.
notes.nextStep: Before making a biophysical claim, specify a physical alphabet, pairing rule and measurable stability or decay criterion. The finite combinatorics supplies no biochemical feasibility result.

notes.title: Dimensions and recovered fragments
notes.summary: Products, tensor products and changes of scalar field give different dimensions. Equal continuum cardinalities do not identify those dimensions, fractal dimensions or physical degrees of freedom.
notes.nextStep: Recover explicit definitions of T₀–T₃ and the intended connecting map. State which structure is preserved before comparing dimensions, dynamics or geometric collapse.

notes.title: Review of the written proofs
notes.summary: The inspected alternating-tower, logistic and finite prime-counting arguments pass the stated checks. Their correctness, literature novelty, research significance and external validation are separate questions.
notes.nextStep: Take the alternating-tower convergence, sharp envelope and two-base classification through a focused novelty search and external review as one coherent small mathematical note.

notes.title: Logistic collapse and vanishing terms
notes.statusLabel: Exact local lemma; brane model open
notes.summary: Exact logistic seed folding and a local cubic vanishing term distinguish orbit identification from derivative cancellation. The recovered geometric detector is kept separate from a physical brane model.
notes.nextStep: Specify the geometric state space, evolution and observable, then prove whether the chosen observable vanishes or the state itself collapses. A physical brane interpretation requires a defined model.
